_comment: Hand-maintained set config. Prices are filled in automatically by scripts/update-prices.ps1. pullRates are the percent of packs containing each rarity, from the study in pullRateSource. A rate given as {percent, match} counts cards whose product name contains 'match' (e.g. Master Ball Pattern) instead of matching on rarity. bulkValuePerPack is an estimate of the non-hit cards in a pack. Optional 'note' is shown on the site for that set. Products with kind 'collection' only count their booster packs (promos and accessories aren't valued). A product's optional 'contents' lists packs by set (plus 'bonus' guaranteed cards) when it isn't just N packs of its own set; 'priceGroupId' says which TCGplayer group lists its price. 'collections' holds products whose packs span several sets.

sets.name: 30th Celebration
sets.note: Every pack has a guaranteed Pikachu Rare. RGB Rares aren't counted yet: their pull rate hasn't been measured.

sets.name: Black Bolt
sets.note: The Black White Rare rate (Victini, Zekrom ex) is a community estimate of about 1 in 496 packs. TCGplayer found none in 700+ packs, so it hasn't been measured precisely.

sets.note: TCGplayer hasn't published rates for this set, so these come from a smaller community study. The Double Rare rate is assumed to match other 2024 sets.
